newsitem.title: ITALY: San Paolo shareholder syndicate dissolved.
newsitem.headline: San Paolo shareholder syndicate dissolved.

text.p: A shareholders syndicate pact in Italy's largest banking company, Istituto Bancario San Paolo di Torino, has been dissolved.

In a tombstone in daily Il Sole 24 Ore on Tuesday, the group said insurer La Fondiaria has sold its 1.6 million shares or 0.2 percent stake in Istituto Bancario San Paolo di Torino to the bank's parent company Gruppo Bancario San Paolo.
In addition, privately-owned confectionery group P. Ferrero & C has also sold its shares in Istituto Bancario San Paolo di Torino to the parent company.
Istituto Bancario San Paolo di Torino is aiming for privatisation in 1997, and some 65 percent of the banking company is currently held by a charity foundation Compagnia di San Paolo.
